80163.subject: Listed everywhere at once
80163.body:
View this post on the web at https://uniswap.substack.com/p/listed-everywhere-at-once

Community news
A DeFi gateway for Japan, built on v4: SMBC Nikko, one of Japan’s largest securities firms, and Nethermind are building a new trading venue on Uniswap. Compliance runs inside a hook, so each pool is built to Japan’s regulatory requirements for investors. Uniswap is supporting development, alongside Base and Nyx Foundation. More here.  [ https://substack.com/redirect/947449bb-a670-409d-bc32-df36e54bd22b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]
OUSD is live on Uniswap: Stable season keeps rolling. This week, Open Standard [ https://substack.com/redirect/ccedde5b-8511-42ad-bab4-1cc062118224?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] launched OUSD, a new payments stablecoin supported by over 200 partners, including Coinbase, Mastercard, Shopify, Stripe, Visa, and more. Uniswap joins the network as a key execution layer for OUSD, with millions in liquidity from day one. Up next: we’re working with Open Standard on a v4 hook that pays OUSD rewards to LPs through the protocol. Full design coming soon.
Where stock tokens trade: Tokenized stocks did $20.9B in DEX volume [ https://substack.com/redirect/1955f00c-7e4e-471b-885a-d600febb2b19?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] over the past 30 days. 40.7% of it went through Uniswap v4, more than any other venue, and another 19.4% through v3. On Robinhood Chain, more than 99% [ https://substack.com/redirect/f98de6a0-0654-4b95-b643-7b3991d277e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] of DeFi stock token deposits sit in Uniswap pools, with total deposits growing 532% over the last month. And over on Base, tokenized equities passed $300 million [ https://substack.com/redirect/aa51102f-d39f-496a-b896-7327a4b2066d?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] in Uniswap volume, about a month after Coinbase listed its first tokenized stocks on the chain.
Gold standard: Paxos Labs launched PAXGy [ https://substack.com/redirect/a5f1e7ab-0e34-4a4e-a795-5f189cc65ba8?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], a new token built on PAX Gold, with Uniswap as its liquidity layer. Of note: Uniswap is now the number one venue onchain for tokenized gold: more than $10B in all-time swap volume, over half of it in 2026.
Split it: We shipped three new updates for API users. Share fees [ https://substack.com/redirect/271d968d-42f9-47b7-a7a1-8331c3f9d3c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] with up to four recipients, unlock faster swaps for your users with instant calldata [ https://substack.com/redirect/e5a7a6dd-f6ac-4d6b-bf93-1f744ff70a37?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and enable bridge and swap in one transaction [ https://substack.com/redirect/105a551e-caac-4a52-b02f-a2cda0851d54?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm
